subject: Activation stitch: Quality monitoring ops checkpoint
messages:
From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@olivehealth.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@olivehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 07 Jun 2028 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: QMon kickoff + prompt sets / initial ask

Hi Priya / Monica,

Thanks again for the demo last week — our execs liked the latency guarantees and the canary ideas. We're ready to move from POC to an initial production pilot focused on triage responses for our care-coordination workflows. Key asks from our side:

- Get the Redwood quality monitoring (QMon) pipeline wired into our staging environment.
- Seed prompt sets for the top 10 triage intents (we'll attach an initial spreadsheet).
- Integrate your eval harness so we can run nightly regression checks against our golden prompts.
- Agreement on canary traffic percentages and rollback criteria tied to regression alerts.

I've attached a CSV with the first draft of prompt examples and a short doc with our compliance team's minimum audit expectations. Procurement is cc'd for SOW/billing questions.

Can we aim for a technical kickoff next Tue (06/13) so your engineers can scope the eval integration work? Please send a short plan and owners for the pieces below: prompt curation, eval harness integration, alert mapping, canary/rollback policy.

Thanks — Alex

--
Alex Rivera
Head of Integrations, Olive Health
ops@olivehealth.com
From: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@olivehealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 07 Jun 2028 11:04:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: QMon kickoff + prompt sets / initial ask

Alex — thanks for the clear asks and the CSV. We're excited to get Olive Health into QMon. High-level plan and owners below:

- Prompt curation (Priya + Marissa): review the CSV, expand negative examples, add edge-case prompts; target: 2 business days.
- Eval harness integration (Karthik): we'll provide a connector that pulls Golden Prompt sets from a secured Drive link and posts nightly runs to your S3/archive; target: initial integration in 5 business days.
- Alert mapping & regression thresholds (Monica): map eval metrics -> channels (PagerDuty + Slack), define soft/hard thresholds and automatic severity; target: propose thresholds in the kickoff.
- Canary & rollback policy (Priya + Eng): propose staged traffic ramp: 2% -> 10% -> 30% over 48 hours with automatic rollback to previous model variant if nightly regression F1 drops by > 3 pts or production error rate increases by > 0.5%.

I'll attach our suggested checklist and a sample canary policy to the kickoff notes. Tue 06/13 11:00am PT works for us for the tech call. Do you prefer a 30 or 60 minute slot?

Action items before kickoff:
- Alex: confirm calendar invite + share a read-only S3 path for evaluation outputs (or a Drive link).
- Procurement: please send SOW redlines if any before Thursday so we can align billing for the pilot.

Thanks,
Priya

--
Priya Natarajan
Customer Success Manager, Redwood Inference
priya.natarajan@redwood.com
From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@olivehealth.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Procurement <procurement@olivehealth.com>
Date: Fri, 08 Jun 2028 08:22:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: QMon kickoff + prompt sets / initial ask

Priya — 60 minutes is better. I've booked Tue 06/13 11:00am PT and shared the S3 read-only path in the calendar invite. Attached are:

- olive_qmon_promptset_v1.csv (seed prompts + expected labels)
- procurement_statement_of_work.docx (attached by procurement)

Couple clarifications:
- Compliance wants a digestible audit trail; can your eval harness provide an immutable run output with per-prompt scores?
- We may need a temporary allowlist for logging token-level outputs for a 30-day window while the audit team validates. Is that configurable per-customer?

I'll also add our platform engineer (Tara) to the invite; she'll join the technical call.

Regards,
Alex
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@olivehealth.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 12 Jun 2028 09:15:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: QMon kickoff + prompt sets / initial ask

Alex / team — quick technical note ahead of the call so we can use the meeting to finalize scope:

1) Eval harness integration model:
   - We'll deliver a lightweight connector that: (a) ingests your seed CSV from the S3 path, (b) runs nightly eval jobs against the canary and baseline model variants, (c) writes run artifacts to the same S3 bucket with a timestamped prefix.
   - Outputs include per-prompt metadata (prompt id, expected label, model output, score) and a summary report (F1 / accuracy / hallucination score).

2) Immutable audit requirements:
   - We can produce signed run manifests (hash + timestamp) and support a 30-day retention window for raw outputs. For longer retention we suggest exporting compressed manifests to your long-term archive.

3) Canary automation options:
   - Redwood can automate rollbacks based on nightly regression alerts OR a hand-off confirmation flow. We'll propose a default: automatic rollback if nightly core-metric delta > threshold + immediate traffic cut if on-call signals a P0.

4) Security note: the ephemeral allowlist for token-level logging is configurable per-customer and will be limited to staging/approval window.

I'll bring a short demo of the harness output format to Tue's call.

- Karthik

--
Karthik Iyer
Staff Engineer, Inference Integrations, Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@olivehealth.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 13 Jun 2028 12:38:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: QMon kickoff + prompt sets / initial ask

Great sync today — notes and immediate next steps below. (Forwarding the recorded link in the related_links entry.)

Decisions made during the call:
- Nightly eval run will compare canary -> baseline for the top 10 intents; primary metric = intent-F1, secondary = hallucination-rate.
- Canary rollout plan: 2% (day 0) -> 10% (day 1) -> 30% (day 2). Nightly guardrails: auto-rollback if intent-F1 drops > 3 pts OR hallucination-rate increases by > 1.5%.
- Audit trail: Karthik will publish signed run manifests; temporary token-level logging enabled in staging for 30 days.

Action owners and ETA: 
- Priya + Marissa: finalize prompt set with negative cases by Fri 06/16.
- Karthik: deliver harness connector + sample run artifact by Mon 06/19.
- Monica: propose alert thresholds + PagerDuty routing by Mon 06/19.
- Alex / Olive: confirm SOW redlines if any by Thu 06/15; confirm Tara for the integration window.

Risks called out:
- If we discover label ambiguity during early eval runs, regression alerts may fire noisily — recommend a short stabilization window where alerts are informational only.

I'll put a short stabilization plan in the shared Drive.

Thanks,
Monica

--
Monica Patel
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
From: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@olivehealth.com>
To: Priya Natarajan <priya.natarajan@redwood.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Karthik Iyer <karthik.iyer@redwood.com>, Procurement <procurement@olivehealth.com>
Date: Thu, 14 Jun 2028 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: QMon kickoff + prompt sets / initial ask

Team — quick confirmation: procurement signed the SOW with one minor invoice scheduling edit (attached). We're green to start integration on Mon 06/19.

Priya/Marissa: we'll upload an expanded prompt set tonight that includes 20 negative-case variants. Karthik: please send the sample artifact format so our compliance team can validate the manifest.

One ask on rollback policy: if an automatic rollback triggers during business hours, can Redwood send a pre-rollback notification to our on-call before switching traffic? We want one human touch for hour-window decisions.

If that's acceptable we'll move forward Monday. Appreciate the clear plan and owners.

Alex

--
Alex Rivera
Head of Integrations, Olive Health
ops@olivehealth.com
